description: When task-cli is on PATH (activated and zero-config configured), blocks a raw tracker write that skips its gates: `gh issue create`/`new`/`close`/`edit`/`comment`/… and `linear issue create`/`update`/…. Allows `task …`, read-only `gh issue list`/`view`, and `gh pr`. Inert when `task` is not on PATH. Fail-closed.
